A benchmark isn't an average or a median:
It's the MLS® Home Price Index estimate for a "typical" home of that type; individual homes sell well above and below it.
Divide a month's sales by active listings (BCREA treats 12–20% as a balanced market).
FVREB publishes days to sell for the whole Fraser Valley, not for South Surrey alone.

Common Questions · South Surrey Real Estate
Is White Rock part of South Surrey?
No. White Rock is its own city, surrounded by South Surrey, with its own council. It shares the Surrey School District, and FVREB reports the two together as \"White Rock / South Surrey\". See
What is the benchmark price for a detached home in South Surrey?
FVREB publishes a monthly detached benchmark for White Rock / South Surrey, a modelled price for a typical house. Specific homes sell well above and below it. Check the
How many detached homes are for sale, and is South Surrey a buyer's or seller's market?

FVREB reports detached homes for sale and sold in White Rock / South Surrey each month and measures market balance with the sales-to-active listings ratio: 12–20% is balanced, below 12% favours buyers and above 20% favours sellers. Check the
current sales, listings and sales-to-active ratios
How do I check the school catchment for a South Surrey home?
Use the South Surrey school catchments guide on this site, then confirm the exact address with the Surrey Schools school locator. Catchments can change year to year.
Can I run a short-term rental in a South Surrey home?
Only in limited cases. Surrey requires the owner to live on the property as their principal residence, doesn't allow tenants to host, and requires a business licence ($358 a year). (
Are these listings up to date?
Yes. The listings on this page come from the MLS® feed and update daily.
